name: tlctc
description: Top Level Cyber Threat Clusters (TLCTC) v2.5, v2.5.1 erratum applied — cause-oriented, axiomatic cyber threat taxonomy. Loads the full framework (10 axioms, 10 clusters, 19 R-* rules incl. the R-SCOPE scope gate, System Risk Event doctrine, DRE refinement tree, attack-path notation) so Claude can classify incidents, CVEs, and threat-intel reports through a causal lens instead of outcome labels.
